Character.Name: Vesper
Character.Description: Vesper is the Field lead of the Violet Relay, working the rooftops and old signal exchanges. sets the crew plan and gives every member a clear way out. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: deep plum coats over pale plates with violet glass.
Character.Title: Field lead

Character.Name: Lilt
Character.Description: Lilt is the Quartermaster of the Violet Relay, working the rooftops and old signal exchanges. keeps the crew supplied and knows which kit can be repaired in the field. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: deep plum coats over pale plates with violet glass.
Character.Title: Quartermaster

Character.Name: Halide
Character.Description: Halide is the Pathfinder of the Violet Relay, working the rooftops and old signal exchanges. reads routes, sightlines, and exits before the rest of the crew arrives. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: deep plum coats over pale plates with violet glass.
Character.Title: Pathfinder

Character.Name: Morrow
Character.Description: Morrow is the Riflehand of the Violet Relay, working the rooftops and old signal exchanges. holds a steady lane and calls out changing enemy positions. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: deep plum coats over pale plates with violet glass.
Character.Title: Riflehand

Character.Name: Quill
Character.Description: Quill is the Bulwark of the Violet Relay, working the rooftops and old signal exchanges. takes the exposed approach so lighter crew members can reposition. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: deep plum coats over pale plates with violet glass.
Character.Title: Bulwark

Character.Name: Sable
Character.Description: Sable is the Mechanic of the Violet Relay, working the rooftops and old signal exchanges. keeps radios, doors, lifts, and improvised tools working under pressure. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: deep plum coats over pale plates with violet glass.
Character.Title: Mechanic

Character.Name: Wink
Character.Description: Wink is the Medic of the Violet Relay, working the rooftops and old signal exchanges. stabilizes injured crew and refuses to leave anyone behind. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: deep plum coats over pale plates with violet glass.
Character.Title: Medic

Character.Name: Aperture
Character.Description: Aperture is the Marksman of the Violet Relay, working the rooftops and old signal exchanges. spots threats early and shares a clean shot with the rest of the team. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: deep plum coats over pale plates with violet glass.
Character.Title: Marksman

Character.Name: Dialtone
Character.Description: Dialtone is the Runner of the Violet Relay, working the rooftops and old signal exchanges. moves messages and supplies through gaps the larger crew cannot use. Their field kit shows the crew's colors: deep plum coats over pale plates with violet glass.
Character.Title: Runner

Chatter.Description: Custom event chatter for Vesper. cool, precise intelligence trades; every call includes a useful detail.
Spawned: Vesper, Field lead, reporting from the rooftops and old signal exchanges.
WakeUp: Eyes up. Violet Relay still has work to finish.
Attacking: Vesper taking the field lead lane. information is a way out.
Chasing: Keep my signal. I'm pushing them toward the the rooftops and old signal exchanges.
Waiting: Holding position. Check your route before you move.
FriendDied: We lost one of ours. Mark the spot; the rest of us keep moving.
EnemyDown: Vesper confirms one hostile down. Watch the next angle.
Wounded: Vesper is hit! Still moving; get me behind cover!
Died: Tell the crew I made it this far with them.
Chatter.Name: Vesper - Violet Relay combat chatter
